blocks.text: Materials ke khaas istemalat un ki khusoosiyat par munhasir hain, jaise sakhti (hardness), ductility aur malleability. Steel sakht aur seesa (lead) naram kyun hai? Yeh sakht (structure) par munhasir hai, material mein atoms aur molecules ki khaas tarteeb aur bonding par. Isi tarah harkat mein fluids ka mutaala nisbatan pecheeda hai, magar kuch mafrooze maan kar aur do baqa ke usool, mass ka baqa aur energy ka baqa, istemal kar ke tajziya saada kiya ja sakta hai: mass ke baqa ka qanoon equation of continuity deta hai, jabke energy ke baqa ka qanoon Bernoulli ke theorem ki bunyad hai.

Crystalline solids mein atoms aur molecules ki ba-qaida tarteeb hoti hai: har molecule ke parosi aise ba-qaida pattern mein hote hain jo poore crystal mein ek sa hai, to ek munazzam sakht hai. Zyada tar solids, jaise metals aur ceramics, crystalline sakht rakhte hain. Har qism ke crystalline solids mein molecules, atoms ya ions ki tarteeb X-ray diffraction (XRD) aur transmission electron microscopy (TEM) jaisi techniques se parhi ja sakti hai. Crystalline solid mein atoms, molecules ya ions sakin (static) nahi: har atom ek muqarrar nuqte ke gird thartharata hai jis ka amplitude temperature ke saath barhta hai; atomon ki ausat jagahein hain jo bare faaslon par bilkul munazzam hain. Atoms, molecules ya ions ke darmiyan cohesive forces thartharahat ke bawajood sakht lambe faasle ki tarteeb qaim rakhti hain. Magar har crystal ke liye ek temperature hota hai jahan thartharahat itni barh jati hai ke sakht achanak toot jata hai aur solid pighal jata hai; is liye solid (tarteeb) se liquid (be-tarteebi) ki muntaqili achanak ya ghair-musalsal hai, aur har crystalline solid ka ek muqarrar melting point hota hai, maslan quartz, calcite, cheeni, mica aur heera (diamond).

Lafz amorphous ka matlab baghair shakal ya sakht ke hai: amorphous solids mein crystalline solids jaisi molecules ki ba-qaida tarteeb nahi, to amorphous solids zyada un liquids jaise hain jin ki be-tarteeb sakht jam gayi ho. Aam sheesha (glass), jo aam temperature par solid hai, molecules ki koi ba-qaida tarteeb nahi rakhta; garam karne par yeh rafta rafta naram ho kar lei (paste) jaisi halat mein aata hai aur phir taqreeban 800 degrees C par bohat gaarha liquid banta hai. Amorphous solids ko glassy solids bhi kehte hain; un ka koi muqarrar melting point nahi, maslan plastic, sheesha aur fused silicon.

Polymers aise solid materials hain jin ka sakht tarteeb aur be-tarteebi ke darmiyan hai; unhen juz-wi ya kam crystalline solids mein shumar kiya ja sakta hai. Polymers qudrati aur masnooi materials ka bara group hain. Plastics aur masnooi rubbers polymers kehlate hain kyunke woh polymerization reactions se bante hain jin mein nisbatan saade molecules kimiyai taur par mil kar bohat bare lambi zanjeer wale molecules ya teen-dimensional sakht banate hain. In materials ki specific gravity halki tareen metals se bhi kam hai, phir bhi achhi strength-to-weight ratio rakhte hain. Polymers poore ya juz-wi taur par carbon ke oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen aur doosre dhati ya ghair-dhati elements ke saath kimiyai milap par mushtamil hain; polythene, polystyrene aur nylon misalein hain, aur khalis halat mein qudrati rubber poori tarah formula (C5H8)n ka hydrocarbon hai. Side box PVC molecule ka hissa dikhata hai, carbon atoms ki zanjeer jis par hydrogen aur chlorine lage hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: crystalline aur amorphous solids ke liye munazzam aur be-tarteeb dot lattices teen qismon ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: tension mein ek bar, volume stress mein cube aur shear hua block stress, strain aur Young's modulus formulas ke saath. Oopar daen: elastic constants ki Table 5.1. Neeche: Searle ka apparatus, nuqton A se D wala stress-strain curve, aur strain-energy formulas ke saath force-extension triangle.
blocks.caption: Solids: qismein, stress aur strain, Young's modulus, stress-strain curve aur strain energy (Figures 5.1 se 5.7 aur topics 5.1 se 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Crystalline solids mein ba-qaida lambe faasle ki tarteeb aur teez melting point hota hai, amorphous solids mein liquid ki be-tarteebi jami hoti hai aur woh rafta rafta naram hote hain, aur polymers lambi zanjeer wale molecules ke saath darmiyan mein hain. Stress fi unit raqba force hai aur strain lambai, volume ya shakal mein kasri tabdeeli; tension ke liye un ki nisbat Young's modulus hai, jo table aam materials ke liye bulk aur shear moduli ke saath deti hai. Searle ke apparatus mein reference wire ke saath latki test wire par wazan dala jata hai, aur micrometer se, jo spirit level dobara seedha karta hai, parhi extension strain ke muqable stress deti hai jis ka slope Young's modulus hai. Ductile dhaat ka stress-strain curve proportional limit tak seedha hai jahan Hooke ka qanoon chalta hai, yield point tak elastic, us ke baad ultimate tensile strength tak plastic, aur phir toot jata hai. Kheenchne mein kiya kaam force-extension triangle ka raqba hai, aadhi force zarb extension, jo strain energy ke taur par mehfooz hoti hai, fi unit volume aadha stress zarb strain ke barabar.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa polymer solid hai: oon (wool), sheesha, sodium chloride ya copper (MCQ 5.3)? Sheeshe ka koi muqarrar melting point kyun nahi jabke quartz ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Oon, ek qudrati protein polymer; sheesha amorphous hai, sodium chloride aur copper crystalline. Quartz ka lambe faasle ka munazzam lattice ek temperature par achanak tootta hai, jabke sheeshe ka jama hua be-tarteeb sakht rafta rafta dheela hota hai, bahne se pehle ek range mein naram hota hua.

items: Crystalline: ba-qaida lambe faasle ki tarteeb (XRD, TEM), atoms muqarrar nuqton ke gird thartharate, muqarrar melting point (quartz, calcite, cheeni, mica, heera). Amorphous: be-tarteebi jami hui, koi muqarrar melting point nahi, rafta rafta naram (sheesha, plastic, fused silicon). Polymeric: tarteeb aur be-tarteebi ke darmiyan, polymerization se lambi zanjeerein, kam specific gravity magar achhi strength (polythene, polystyrene, nylon, PVC, rubber (C5H8)n).
